items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: And I worked there one time with wonderful Ivy Anderson.

ctx.x: So when -- that's why I think when finally, when the big thing did happen to me, when I did get, you know, get my break through records, well many people remembered, and I'm very grateful for that. I'm very grateful for that, because I've met many people who have told me, said, 'You know, I

remember seeing you at the Club Royal, and one time I even worked the Swanee Inn, and that was -- oh, that was long before I made records. And I worked there one time with wonderful Ivy Anderson. That's a person whose name -- I think we mentioned her earlier, when we were talking about the Chicken Shack.
